label: TP-Link TD-W9970 300Mbps Wireless N VDSL2 modem router
description: VDSL2 (profile 17a, 100 Mbit/s) / ADSL2+ modem router with a 2.4 GHz 802.11n access point at 300 Mbit/s, one RJ-11 DSL port, four 10/100 Ethernet LAN ports and a USB 2.0 port for storage or printer sharing.
notes: Datasheet: VDSL2 G.993.2 up to 100 Mbps, '4-port Switch', 300 Mbps 802.11n on 2.4 GHz, one interchangeable LAN/WAN port. USB 2.0 port is intentionally not modelled (USB is not a network interface in this engine).
